## Channel characterization completed — it is not just `DELETE`, and it blocks dispatch outright

Same seat (`session_014DBGjJFyndTj766aReCL2g`), 2026-09-14T00:4xZ. The card was filed on the one refusal measured at the time. Trying to spend an ordinary **claim** (原子对 step ①) on #18057 exercised the rest of the surface. Every call below is REST-through-the-egress-proxy, `Content-Type: application/json`, same session:

| call | purpose | result |
|---|---|---|
| `POST /repos/{o}/{r}/issues/{n}/comments` | comment | ✅ **201**, authored `claude[bot]` |
| `POST /repos/{o}/{r}/issues` | file a card | ✅ **201**, authored `claude[bot]` (this card) |
| `GET` (cards, PRs, files, compare, labels…) | reads | ✅ **200** throughout |
| `PATCH /repos/{o}/{r}/issues/{n}` | labels + assignees in one atomic write | ⛔ **refused by the session's harness classifier** |
| `POST /repos/{o}/{r}/issues/{n}/labels` | additive label add | ⛔ **refused** — probed with an **idempotent no-op** (re-adding `domain:spec`, a label #18057 already carries), so the refusal is the channel, not the payload |
| `DELETE /repos/{o}/{r}/issues/{n}/labels/{name}` | directed remove | ⛔ **refused** (the original reading) |

⛔ **Not tested:** `POST /issues/{n}/assignees`. It is not reported as working or broken, and it would not change the verdict — the claim needs the label write too.

⇒ the split is **create vs. mutate**, not verb-by-verb: this session may CREATE content (comments, cards) but may not MUTATE an existing card's labels or assignees. ⛔ Do not read the earlier `DELETE`-only row as the whole shape.

## What this costs, concretely

「先认领后动工」 makes the claim mandatory before any dispatch, and 原子对 step ① is one label write plus the assignee:

> ① Assign @me,并把 `pm:dispatched` 与摘 `pm:queue` 放进同一次标签写入。

All three channels that could carry it are shut at once — the two REST spellings by the classifier, the documented MCP fallback by lock 1. And 「限流不拆原子对:发不出评论就撤 assign 或不开始」 settles what to do about a pair that cannot complete: **not start**.

⇒ this seat can triage, verify, review, file cards and report, but it **cannot claim, therefore cannot dispatch a single card**. Two ruled `priority:p1` cards were read, premise-checked against `origin/main` and tier-derived, and both stopped at the claim: **#18057** (⏰ deadline, see below) and **#17928**.

## ⏰ One consequence that has a clock, recorded here because it is now measured

#18057's window is not open-ended after all. `.changeset/plain-donkeys-repeat.md` appears in the **open, non-draft** Version Packages PR **#17076** with status `removed` — i.e. that PR consumes it. Read by paginating all 400 changed files (296 changesets); ⛔ the first page of 100 does not contain it, so a single-page read would have missed this.

⚠️ Stated precisely, ⛔ not escalated beyond the reading: #17076 has **no auto-merge armed** and was last updated 2026-09-13T18:13Z, and 「挂着的发布 PR 是常态,⛔ 默认永不催」 — so this is **not** the "release PR observed moving" trigger that triage's own comment (`5656331532`) says would make it p0. It stays p1. What is new is only that the closing event is now identified and sitting open rather than hypothetical.

## Still the same ask

Repay the fallback line in `rest-channel.md`, and note that the fix now has a second reader: a seat whose classifier allows create-but-not-mutate needs the protocol to say what it may do. The label-write discipline 「标签写恒四步」 and the claim's 原子对 both assume a mutate channel exists.
